limitations: This audit reads source and small metadata only. It does not independently decode/re-hash checkpoint, calibration, sample/archive or pixel payloads; recorded identities remain the provenance boundary. Parent merger handles actual archive integrity and image evaluation.

Cross-native bitwise output validation covers the recorded16-image parity at each new seed, supported by unchanged official code paths and all1000 actual noise/label input hashes. This is not an independently rerun1000-image output parity experiment.

Legacy and native use distinct arithmetic/RNG layouts and distinct historical seeds; their baselines cannot be interchanged. Native global has no paired historical1K official201, so its additional201 reference is new4K only.

Legacy separate T and observed decoder counts are missing; historical legacy/spatial outer wall is missing. Null totals and known subtotals are retained, never silently replaced by zero or inferred counts.

Call-count provenance varies by runner: reflection uses hooks, legacy uses loop bookkeeping, spatial uses fixed N/B/steps formulas. Verified expected NFE should not be described as independently hook-observed for every arm.
Spatial trajectory+decode component sum is not the reflection whole-span T. Main NFE matching does not absorb projection/calibration/preparation overhead.

Reflection official201 exceeds pooled candidate recorded T by about0.3144% and W by about0.3269%. These are noisy elapsed point estimates, not confidence bounds, exact hardware-cost equality, integrated GPU busy time or fair total research cost.
The four worker walls overlap child walls and overlap in calendar time. Sum is an allocated-process elapsed proxy, cannot be added to child time or called parallel elapsed.

Physical accounting includes discarded historical official200 and all recorded parity formula checks. Calibration/training/earlier failed studies/evaluation and other research costs are not fully closed by these summaries.

The old1K candidate selection used already-seen historical metrics. Five interacting N1000 cohorts remain five separate cohorts; this audit makes no iid5000 assumption and no FID/quality/SOTA claim. No new FID output or generated image was read.
